dedupe_keys.name: lifecycle ageing tests on commercial 18650 li ion cell 25 c and 45 c

description: VITO provides cycling-ageing results for commercial nickel-rich/silicon-graphite 18650 cells at twenty-five and forty-five degrees Celsius. Conditions vary C-rate and environmental temperature, with two cells per condition. A ten-to-ninety-percent state-of-charge window is defined using fresh cells and is kept fixed throughout ageing. Reference tests interrupt cycling. The native source identifies CSV files and EVERLASTING documentation. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent collection establishes calibration inputs for predicting electric-vehicle battery behaviour, lifetime and range. Coverage: exact measurement periods remain unstated. Access: public native metadata describes the release and stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The exact C-rates, dates and sampling interval are unstated. Native data links are retained as related leads and are not silently equated with this release. Related calendar-ageing and lower-temperature datasets have different protocols.
